text_solutions.text:
"The correct answer is: 3. 10th to 17th day
The chances of fertilization are highest around the ovulation period, which typically occurs on the 14th day of a regular 28-day menstrual cycle. However, sperm can survive in the female reproductive tract for up to 5 days, so fertilization can occur if intercourse takes place within the 10th to 17th day range of the cycle. :
  • First 5 days: This is too early for ovulation, so fertilization chances are low.
  • Last 7 days: This is after ovulation, and the egg only survives for about 24 hours, making fertilization unlikely.
  • 10th to 17th day: This is around the ovulation window, so it has the highest chances for fertilization.
  • Thus, 10th to 17th day is the period with the highest chances of fertilization.
"
